generator: For each block generate 40 cases sequentially from Python random.Random(seed). n=randint(3,7), C in [30,45,60], initial randint(0,15), terminal randint(2,8); d=randint(3,16), reserve=randint(0,min(2,terminal)), available=(random()>0.2); price randint(30,100)*10. Supply=C, except limited block randint(0,C); minimum=0 except limited block choice(0,3,8,15); fixed=0 except nonzero blocks choice(0,100,500,1500); variable=0 except nonzero blocks choice(0,5,20). No resampling, exclusion, or screening by result.
comparison: Unweighted case counts; pooled cost difference sum(policy-optimum), pooled percentage=sum(policy-optimum)/sum(policy), only pairwise jointly feasible. Report all-policy common feasible denominator separately. Never substitute solver output into policy plans.
policy_failure: Invalid ledger or unable to make requested positive purchase satisfying minimum, upper supply, capacity and remaining exact total; diagnostic classification conditioned on reference status.
solver: Unmodified copied scipy LP/MILP prototype with independent sequential audit; all inputs same. Continuous q, grid constraint applies to inputs only.
